title: DealerIQ AI — Automotive Dealership CRM
keyResult: Identified and resolved 7 critical regressions in 1 pre-release cycle before client demo

overview.product: DealerIQ AI is a high-volume automotive CRM platform providing AI voice calling agents, conversational chat bots, lead pipeline tracking, vehicle appraisals, deal contracts, paperwork generation, and carrier shipment dispatch.
overview.role: Associate SQA Engineer responsible for end-to-end regression validation, REST API checks, and release gate certification.

challenge: High concurrency workflows between telephony webhooks and browser state led to race conditions. Re-routing between deal negotiation and carrier shipment tabs desynchronized paperwork fee calculations and silently dropped active filters.

testStrategy.scope: Authentication, lead lifecycle, AI call webhooks, deal contracts, fee calculation engine, and shipment tracking.

sampleTestCases.title: AI Voice Webhook Deduplication on NO_ANSWER
sampleTestCases.steps: Simulate telephony provider webhook with duplicate CallSID within 400ms retry window.
sampleTestCases.expected: Idempotency key prevents second record; exactly 1 fallback SMS queued.
sampleTestCases.actual: Single SMS queued, lead timeline reflects 1 log entry.

sampleTestCases.title: Deal Paperwork Fee Persistence Across Tab Switch
sampleTestCases.steps: Load Deal #9482, add custom dealer addon ($450), navigate to Shipment tab, return to Paperwork.
sampleTestCases.expected: Line-item fee calculation preserves $450 addon without state reset.

sampleTestCases.title: Unread AI Chat Filter Persistence During Table Sort
sampleTestCases.steps: Apply filter 'Unread AI Follow-Up', click 'Last Contacted' sort column header.
sampleTestCases.expected: Table re-sorts while maintaining active filter criteria.
sampleTestCases.actual: Filter remains applied; table sorted correctly.

sampleBug.steps:
1. Open Deal #9482 with active paperwork.
2. Apply chat filter 'Unread AI Follow-Up'.
3. Click Shipment Navigation tab to switch view.
4. Inspect fee table network response (GET /api/v1/deals/paperwork).
sampleBug.expected: Shipment tab loads while preserving active paperwork calculation total ($42,850.00).
sampleBug.actual: Stale query parameter resets deal context, clearing chat filter and displaying $0.00 total.
sampleBug.impact: Would have caused dealership sales managers to misquote paperwork during customer checkout. Prevented pre-release.

automation.pattern: Page Object Model (POM) with isolated fixture states
automation.ciIntegration: Runs headless on pull requests via GitHub Actions across Chromium and WebKit.

results.regressionTimeSaved: Reduced release sign-off cycle from 2 days to 3.5 hours
results.releaseQuality: Zero high-severity escapes into client demonstrations or production

learnings: Early cross-functional alignment between frontend React state and telephony webhook idempotency keys is essential to prevent ghost events in real-time CRM dashboards.
